verses.text: I pray that the LORD will listen when you are in trouble, and that the God of Jacob will keep you safe.
May the LORD send help from his temple and come to your rescue from Mount Zion.
May he remember your gifts and be pleased with what you bring.
May God do what you want most and let all go well for you.
Then you will win victories, and we will celebrate, while raising our banners in the name of our God. May the LORD answer all your prayers!
I am certain, LORD, that you will help your chosen king. You will answer my prayers from your holy place in heaven, and you will save me with your mighty arm.
Some people trust the power of chariots or horses, but we trust you, LORD God.
Others will stumble and fall, but we will be strong and stand firm.
Give the king victory, LORD, and answer our prayers.

footnotes.text: victory … prayers: Or “victory. He (God or the king) answers us.”
